$description: Motion: transitions, keyframe animations, reduced motion.

com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

motion.$description: Motion. Transitions are DTCG transition composites; keyframe animations extend a transition with keyframes, iteration and direction.

transition.$description: Named transitions and the properties they animate.

color.$description: Colour, ground and border changes on controls.

surface.$description: Card ground and text colour on hover.

reveal.$description: Rise-in of page blocks (with a stagger delay).

anchor.$description: Heading anchor reveal (delay drops to 0 on direct hover).

settle.$description: Tilted cards settling on hover: they straighten to interaction.tilt.settle-factor of their tilt, lift interaction.lift.settle and scale to interaction.scale.settle.

sheet-enter.$description: Bottom sheet and full-screen menu entering.

sheet-settle.$description: Bottom sheet settling after a drag: back to its detent when the drag does not dismiss it, or up to the large detent.

gesture-settle.$description: A released swipe row or pull-to-refresh indicator settling: back to rest, open at its actions, or held at the refresh position.

badge-enter.$description: A badge appearing on its host (it scales up from component.badge.enter-scale as it fades in).

animation.$description: Keyframe animations. Keyframe values are identity literals (opacity 0 or 1, scale 1, translate and rotate 0), token references ("-{...}" negates) or per-cell slots (on, p1, p2) that the component fills from the tokens in the animation's on / peaks extension.

heartbeat.$description: Pulse ring behind a live element, scaled from the pulse origin.

loader-fill.$description: Loader: cells fill and empty in sequence (reading, spiral or rise order; motion.loader.fill-step apart). 'on' is fill-on for pattern cells, fill-other for the rest.

loader-twinkle.$description: Loader: cells twinkle (alternate). Each cell draws its own cycle (twinkle-duration-min to -max) and start offset. 'on' is twinkle-on for pattern cells, twinkle-other for the rest.

loader-emerge.$description: Loader: the pattern holds at full ink while the other cells flash on and off around it (loader duration x 1.6; per-cell delays emerge-delay-min to -max).

loader-emerge-slow.$description: Loader: slow emerge, track a (loader duration x 2.6). Each non-pattern cell runs track a, b or c with its own delay (emerge-slow-delay-min to -max).

loader-emerge-slow-b.$description: Loader: slow emerge, track b: two steps up, a step down, rest.

loader-emerge-slow-c.$description: Loader: slow emerge, track c: on, a flicker, on, a dip and a flicker, rest.

loader-emerge-drift.$description: Loader: drifting emerge (loader duration x 2.7): a step up, full, a step down, rest (per-cell delays emerge-drift-delay-min to -max).

loader-sparse.$description: Loader: sparse two-phase emerge; each non-pattern cell draws peaks p1 and p2 from the peaks list, its cycle (sparse-duration-min to -max) and start offset.

loader-sparse-fast.$description: Loader: sparse emerge, fast (sparse-fast-duration-min to -max per cell).

loader-drop.$description: Loader: pattern cells drop into place one after another (motion.loader.drop-step apart), hold, then fade.

loader-chase.$description: Loader: a lit cell chases around the pattern (loader duration x 0.7; cells motion.loader.chase-step of the loader duration apart).

loader-spin.$description: Loader: the pattern turns once per cycle in four 90-degree steps.

loader-orbit.$description: Loader: the centre column breathes (squashes vertically) while the ring cells step round it (motion.loader.orbit-steps per cycle).

hero-lift.$description: Scroll-driven lift of the fill hero: moves up 40vh across the first 80vh of scroll (regular widths, motion allowed).

screen-in-forward.$description: Forward navigation (a push): the incoming screen slides in from the inline end by interaction.shift.screen as it fades in.

screen-out-forward.$description: Forward navigation: the outgoing screen moves toward the inline start as it fades out.

screen-in-back.$description: Back navigation (a pop): the screen returned to comes back from the inline start; quicker than a push.

screen-out-back.$description: Back navigation: the screen being left moves toward the inline end as it fades out.

screen-fade-in.$description: Switching between peer screens (tab bar destinations, segmented views): the new screen fades in, without movement.

screen-fade-out.$description: Switching between peer screens: the old screen fades out.

modal-in.$description: A full-screen modal (compose, edit) rising from interaction.shift.modal below as it fades in.

modal-out.$description: A full-screen modal sinking as it fades out.

skeleton-pulse.$description: Skeleton placeholders breathe between full opacity and opacity.50; they hold still under reduced motion.

refresh-spin.$description: Pull to refresh: the indicator turns while the refresh runs (one turn per cycle); under reduced motion it holds still and the status line says Refreshing.

loader.$description: Loader cell values and per-cell choreography. Pattern cells are the loader's .is-pattern cells; per-cell values are drawn once per cell (the reference uses a seeded generator, so a loader looks the same on every render).

rest.$description: Resting cell opacity between beats (fill, emerge, sparse, tetris).

fill-on.$description: Fill loader: pattern cells at full ink.

fill-step.$description: Fill loaders: delay between consecutive cells as a fraction of the loader duration (reading, spiral and rise orders).

twinkle-offset-min.$description: Twinkle loader: smallest start offset (each cell starts this far into its cycle; a negative animation delay).

sparse-offset-min.$description: Sparse loader: smallest start offset (each cell starts this far into its cycle; a negative animation delay).

sparse-fast-offset-min.$description: Sparse-fast loader: smallest start offset (each cell starts this far into its cycle; a negative animation delay).

chase-step.$description: Chase loader: delay between consecutive cells round the pattern, as a fraction of the loader duration.

emerge-on.$description: Emerge loaders: pattern cells hold at full ink; other cells peak here.

emerge-delay-min.$description: Emerge loader: shortest per-cell start delay.

emerge-delay-max.$description: Emerge loader: longest per-cell start delay.

emerge-slow-delay-min.$description: Emerge slow loader: shortest per-cell start delay.

emerge-slow-delay-max.$description: Emerge slow loader: longest per-cell start delay.

emerge-drift-delay-min.$description: Emerge drift loader: shortest per-cell start delay.

emerge-drift-delay-max.$description: Emerge drift loader: longest per-cell start delay.

slow-a-rise.$description: Slow emerge, track a: first step up.

slow-a-fall.$description: Slow emerge, track a: step down before rest.

slow-b-rise.$description: Slow emerge, track b: first step up.

slow-b-lift.$description: Slow emerge, track b: second step up.

slow-b-fall.$description: Slow emerge, track b: step down before rest.

slow-c-flicker.$description: Slow emerge, track c: flicker between full steps.

slow-c-dip.$description: Slow emerge, track c: dip before the last flicker.

drift-rise.$description: Drifting emerge: step up before full.

drift-fall.$description: Drifting emerge: step down before rest.

drop-offset.$description: Drop loader: start offset of a falling cell.

drop-step.$description: Drop loader: delay between consecutive pattern cells (reading order).

spin-turn.$description: Spin loader: one full turn per cycle, taken in steps.

orbit-squash.$description: Orbit loader: vertical scale of the centre column at mid-cycle.

orbit-steps.$description: Orbit loader: steps per cycle; on each step the pattern cells of the ring round the centre move one place clockwise (the source orbits the six cells of its mark in six steps; the 3 x 3 ring of a 5 x 5 grid has eight places). Each step is a whole step (steps(1, end)).

tetris-steps.$description: Tetris loader: the cycle is this many equal steps; cells change only on step boundaries (steps(1, end) per keyframe). Pattern cells land one per step from the bottom row up and hold.

tetris-flash-step.$description: Tetris loader: step at which the completed pattern dims to tetris-dim; it lights on the next step, dims again, then clears.

tetris-clear-steps.$description: Tetris-clear loader: steps per cycle (whole steps, as the tetris loader).

tetris-clear-flash-step.$description: Tetris-clear loader: step at which the completed pattern dims.

tetris-dim.$description: Tetris loaders: a completed pattern dims to this opacity twice before clearing.

distance.$description: Scroll lift: how far the fill hero rises (vh).

range.$description: Scroll lift: scroll distance over which it rises (vh from the top).

duration.$description: Every duration under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Tilts, lifts, reveals, scroll lift and loader animation stop; opacity changes remain instant.
